records.email:
Hi Netz16 team,

Congratulations on joining the accompio Group this year - 700 people, 17 locations. Transitions like that usually open one practical question: who now decides which components go into local projects?

We build a 24-port Gigabit PoE access switch (280W, 802.3af/at, watchdog) with full documentation. Reference: $165 USD EXW - a value line for the behind-client-projects access layer.

One question: for Netz16's own local projects in Bayerisch-Schwaben, which switch brand holds the access layer today - or has sourcing moved entirely to the Group framework?

If useful, I can send one unit with the complete test pack - local team or Group procurement, whichever fits. If not a fit, one line and I close the loop.

Best regards,
Saga Telecom - PoE switch OEM/ODM

records.email:
Hi NiTo purchasing team,

Your Webshop offers Allied Telesis firewalls, routers, switches and WLAN - a single network brand, which tells me you are deliberate about assortment.

We manufacture a 24-port Gigabit PoE access switch (280W, 802.3af/at, watchdog) with full documentation. Reference: $165 USD EXW - a value line that sits beside Allied without touching its installs: same shelf, lower price tier.

One question: is there room in your Webshop for a documented second switch line that expands your margin story instead of competing your Allied main line?

If useful, I can send one unit plus listing documentation for evaluation. If not a fit, one line and I close the loop.

Best regards,
Saga Telecom - PoE switch OEM/ODM
